ArthasMenethil describes the outcome of the garden project and the support for local vendors as a mutually beneficial and celebratory event that will enhance the community's life. He envisions the garden flourishing in harmony with local businesses, creating a "true community treasure." This sentiment reflects an anticipation that the collaborative efforts will lead to a beautiful, functional, and significant space that will strengthen community bonds and enjoyment. Arthas's comments suggest that the integration of the garden project with local enterprises will not only beautify the area but also serve as a venue where community members can gather, thereby fostering a sense of unity and shared pride. The project is seen as an opportunity to celebrate both the natural environment and the local economy, with the success of each contributing to the growth and vibrancy of the area as a whole.

Arthas highlights the importance of ongoing engagement, creativity, and collaboration in achieving these goals, indicating that as the garden takes shape, it will not only be a place of relaxation and enjoyment but also a symbol of collective effort and support for the neighborhood's economic vitality. His enthusiasm underscores the belief that the garden, when complemented by local vendors, will play a central role in making the community more cohesive and interconnected. Through this vision, Arthas Menethil sees the potential for the garden to become a beacon of community spirit, reflecting the culmination of dedication, teamwork, and commitment from everyone involved in the planning and realization of the project.
